findings.evidence: PrincipalSymbol.lean:104-182 (`vanishingIdealDifferential`, `covectorLift`, `evalOneAt`, `smoothCommutatorSymbol`, `smoothCommutatorSymbol_mvfderiv`) matches Complex.lean:117-212 up to the ℝ→ℂ swap. The generic `cotangentSymbol` with `cotangentSymbol_comp_perm` and `cotangentSymbol_comp_const` already exists at RingTheory/Derivation/PrincipalSymbol.lean:402,447,463, and `mk_algebraMap_complexSmoothCommutatorSymbol` shows the complex symbol is just its transport.
findings.fix: Build the symbol once in `TauCeti/RingTheory/Derivation/PrincipalSymbol.lean`, taking a 𝕜-algebra `A`, an ideal `J` with `A ⧸ J ≃ 𝕜`, and `e : J.Cotangent ≃ₗ[𝕜] V`, and define it by transporting `cotangentSymbol` through `e` and `A ⧸ J ≃ 𝕜`. Derive symmetry, homogeneity and composition from `cotangentSymbol_comp_perm`/`cotangentSymbol_comp_const`, then instantiate the real case with `smoothCotangentEquiv` and the complex case with `complexSmoothCotangentEquiv`.
findings.issue: Special-case duplication: `complexIdealDifferential`, `exists_complexIdealDifferential_comp_eq_id`, `complexCovectorLift` (+ `_apply_self`, `mvfderiv_`), `evalOneAt`, `complexSmoothCommutatorSymbol` (+ `_mvfderiv`, `_comp_perm`), `mk_algebraMap_complexSmoothCommutatorSymbol`, `forall_complexSmoothCommutatorSymbol_eq_zero_iff`, `complexSmoothPrincipalSymbol` (+ `_def`, `_mvfderiv`, `_zero`, `_add`, `_smul`, `_smul_covector`, `_comp`, `_derivation_mvfderiv`) copy the real versions in `PrincipalSymbol.lean` (lines 104-330) with ℝ replaced by ℂ. The only case-specific inputs are the cotangent equivalence and the I_x^2 membership criterion.

summary: The complex principal-symbol construction copies the real one in `PrincipalSymbol.lean` line for line, when one field-generic construction built on the existing algebraic `cotangentSymbol` would cover both. The order-one splitting and the `ComplexDerivation` lemma are at the natural level.
